extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.notes: lies flat on its rolled rim, front (boss) facing +Z like round-shield; domed steel shell, rolled brass rim, brass ring with rivets, steel boss on a riveted brass flange with a small sun disc; steel grip bar with leather wrap inside the hollow back (does not touch the ground); rotate 90 deg around X to hold it upright; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
